notes.note: decmatch template is only declared, not used in matching, to avoid depending on a codec; encode attribute "RAW" is tool-specific. Same applies to 15.07.01_test_008/009/010.
Titan rejects AnyElementsOrNone inside an array template ({1, *}); B.1.3.2 explicitly allows * inside arrays (see example MyStrings:{"abyz", *, "abc"}), so the Titan warning is a tool limitation.
Ambiguity: AnyValueOrNone for set of is only used for an optional field and as a whole template, which is valid under both readings (with or without NOTE 1).

Titan requires a proprietary 'extension "anytype ..."' attribute to populate anytype; per clause 6.2.0 anytype contains all types known in the module (incl. integer, charstring), so the Titan warning is a tool deviation.
Titan does not support enumerated values with associated value lists (e_other(1 .. 100)) and the EnumValueIdentifier(TemplateBody...) template; the rest of the module is accepted by Titan.
Ambiguity: tested integer and float ranges only (common to both readings); character string ranges are covered by 15.07.01_test_010.
Requires a codec: uses encvalue with tool-specific encode "RAW" and relies on encode/decode round-trip of an integer payload.
Titan does not support enumerated types with associated value lists (Other(2 .. 365)); test follows the example of B.1.2.10, Titan warning is a tool limitation.
Use of an unbound value cannot in general be detected statically; tested as a runtime error (ttcn3verdict:error) using an unbound variable in a template list.
Tested as a runtime error (ttcn3verdict:error) using an unbound variable inside a permutation.
